name: List
summary: A vertical list of uniform rows — avatar + title/description meta and trailing actions, with size, bordered and split options.
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-list> — defined once, imported unchanged by React and Vue. Feed it structured rows via `items` (each { title, description?, avatar?, actions? } lays out a leading avatar, a title + description meta block, and a trailing actions cluster), or drop light-DOM children for plain free-form rows. Config: `size` (small · default · large row padding), `bordered` (outer container border), `split` (row dividers, on by default), `list-title` (header), `footer`, and a `loading` skeleton. Rows highlight on hover when interactive; the last row drops its divider. Zero drift — the same element, not two look-alikes. Emits a composed `action`.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. React (< 19) consumes it via a thin ref wrapper that listens for `action`; Vue binds the custom element natively. The primitive is defined once in @ahaslides-product/design.

props.name: items
props.desc: Structured rows: { title, description?, avatar? (icon name), actions?:[{ key, icon, danger?, label? }] }

props.name: (children)
props.desc: Free-form fallback — each light-DOM child renders as one plain row (used when `items` is empty)

props.name: split
props.desc: Row dividers; set split="false" to remove them

props.name: loading
props.desc: Show shimmer skeleton rows in place of content

props.name: action
props.desc: Composed event on a trailing action click, detail { key, index }

whenToUse.when: many uniform rows of the same shape (recent items, participants, feeds)
multi-column records that need sorting or alignment
one titled group of mixed content

opinion.note: Keep rows to one shape — a title, optionally a description and a small trailing actions cluster. Reserve `bordered` for a standalone list; drop the border when the list sits inside a card. For dense multi-column data reach for the Table instead.
opinion.dsv3: COVERED — DS V3's measured set has no dedicated data-List container cell (search returns only list icons + the distinct Upload List Item primitive); the matrix follows antd List conventions over the DS token layer: size (small/default/large row padding), bordered (outer border), split (row dividers), optional header/footer, item content = optional avatar + title/description meta + trailing actions, and a loading state. Tokens: white surface, border #E3E3E3, split #F1F1F1, radius-lg 12, bg-accent avatar, color-primary glyph, color-error danger action, text-default/secondary/tertiary. Motion bound to the shared motion tokens on persistent nodes. A deliberate, documented extension — not a measured match.
